body.message:
We are doing our best to deposit the payment today. However, due to an unexpected workload, there has been a delay.

The cash is ready, so if you need the payment today, you are welcome to collect it from our office before 5:00 PM.

Otherwise, we kindly ask for your patience until 6:00 PM. We will complete the bank deposit and send you the payment receipt as soon as it has been processed.
